derivation: the main flow works. 1 thing in the build does not match what you asked for — the mix-ratio status line (t-3-ac1) — and none of them is from the PRD itself: worth reading before you merge.

criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: Every recorded batch sits in one list right under the header — B-1041 · sanded · charcoal, B-1042 · unsanded · alabaster, B-1043 · epoxy · slate, one line each on the page.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The board carries its own add row — a 'new batch code' input across the width with an ADD BATCH button on its right, so a batch is added right here without leaving the page.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top names it GROUT TRACKER (background rgb(224,138,60)), exactly the naming header the concept asks for.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list sits directly beneath the header — the header ends at y=51 and the batch list starts at y=71, the first thing under it, matching the drawing.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The ADD BATCH button is to the right of the input, as drawn — the input runs from x=20 for 1263px and the button sits at x=1293, right of it.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has a mix-ratio status line in orange sitting beneath the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer.
No screen shows this, but your own suite covers it and it passes — the batches survive a restart.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: I could not check this. It makes no visual claim, and your suite — though green — only exercises a CSV parser (quoted commas, whitespace); nothing in it speaks to the export writing a header row.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: a mix-ratio status line in orange sitting beneath the add row
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page drops straight to the footer, and the page has no status-line element at all

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There's a footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build' along the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call too.
No console errors were reported on the page.
summary: Captain, the board runs and reads well: an orange GROUT TRACKER header, all three batches in one list directly beneath it, and an add row with the ADD BATCH button on the right — all three of your PRD goals are met, and your own tests confirm batches survive a restart. The one miss is the mix-ratio status line your drawing puts beneath the add row: it isn't there at all, the page drops straight to the footer. The CSV-header-row export I couldn't settle — the green suite only tests a parser, not that behaviour.
